nights.title: PA Sports
nights.name: PA Sports
nights.extract: Parham Vakili, known professionally as PA Sports, is a German rapper and music producer. He has produced over a dozen albums and over fifty singles. He is also the founder and owner of the music label Life is Pain.

en.who: Parham Vakili, known professionally as PA Sports, is a german rapper and music producer. he runs his own label, Life is Pain.
